title: Ant Colony
description: Grow an ant colony on a living pheromone grid: ants lay and follow home and food trails, the queen turns food into brood, and tunnels, scouts and soldiers decide whether you outlast beetles, rain and a rival colony for 20 days.

achievements.title: First Harvest
achievements.desc: Bring the first crumb of food home to the nest.

achievements.title: Trail Blazer
achievements.desc: Deliver 400 food to the nest in a single colony.

achievements.title: Eyes On The Meadow
achievements.desc: Unlock the Scout Corps and raise your first scout.

achievements.title: Standing Army
achievements.desc: Field 15 living soldiers at the same time.

achievements.title: Week One
achievements.desc: Keep the queen alive through 7 days.

achievements.title: Full Granary
achievements.desc: Hold 1500 food in the nest store at once.

achievements.title: Rival Routed
achievements.desc: Raze the rival colony's nest to the ground.

achievements.title: Untouched Queen
achievements.desc: Complete 20 days without the queen taking a single wound.
